nodes.label: EU AI Act Observatory
nodes.description: Articles, obligations, actors, application dates and changes of the AI Act, from official EU sources.

nodes.label: Concept Constellation
nodes.description: Curated concepts read across myth, philosophy, Riksdag speeches and the AI Act, with typed relations.

nodes.label: Job market in numbers
nodes.description: Every ad in Arbetsförmedlingen's archives since 2020, and semantic clusters of IT ads.

nodes.label: Philosophy Atlas
nodes.description: Semantic atlas of public-domain philosophy with dominance metrics and tension lenses.

nodes.label: Swedish politics in numbers
nodes.description: Votes, budgets, debates, elections, taxes and news, as one product with seven themes.

nodes.label: Symbolic Atlas
nodes.description: Unsupervised map of symbol words in myth and literature, with human review.

nodes.label: How is Sweden doing?
nodes.description: Jobs, health, trust and welfare from five public sources.

nodes.label: bridge_ai_act_article_actor
nodes.description: Article × actor mentions and "shall" sentences (derived).

nodes.label: bridge_ai_act_article_guidance
nodes.description: Article × Commission guidance (curated list).

nodes.label: bridge_ai_act_article_reference
nodes.description: Article → article cross-references (derived by pattern).

nodes.label: bridge_cluster_concept
nodes.description: Reviewed links between atlas clusters and concepts; empty until a person reviews.

nodes.label: bridge_job_skills
nodes.description: One row per job and detected technology mention using seed regex patterns. Includes title, description and structured skills; does not establish requirements or proficiency.

nodes.label: dim_age_group
nodes.description: Age bands as sources publish them. Bands from different sources overlap and are compared only like with like.

nodes.label: dim_ai_act_actor
nodes.description: The Act's actors under their official terms with the Article 3 definition verbatim.

nodes.label: dim_ai_act_annex
nodes.description: The annexes of the current consolidated text.

nodes.label: dim_ai_act_article
nodes.description: The articles of the current consolidated text, English and Swedish, with change status and application date.

nodes.label: dim_ai_act_document
nodes.description: The AI Act's documents from Cellar; one regulation version is current.

nodes.label: dim_ai_act_guidance
nodes.description: Commission guidance, codes of practice and templates, read from the Commission's pages.

nodes.label: dim_ai_act_recital
nodes.description: The recitals of the Official Journal text.

nodes.label: dim_ai_act_risk_class
nodes.description: The risk classes and the sentence each rests on.

nodes.label: dim_concept
nodes.description: Curated concepts with an anchor sentence per language (interpretation).

nodes.label: dim_corpus
nodes.description: The four corpora and the size of their sample.

nodes.label: dim_country
nodes.description: ESS participating countries.

nodes.label: dim_date
nodes.description: Calendar, one row per day 1968-2030. Also the semantic layer's time spine.

nodes.label: dim_diagnosis
nodes.description: ICD-10 chapters as grouped by Försäkringskassan, plus F43 inside F00-F99.

nodes.label: dim_election_count
nodes.description: Valmyndigheten's count per Riksdag election on its results site: election date, count status (preliminary or final) and last update. Read by platform/publish/export_parliament.py.

nodes.label: dim_employer
nodes.description: Type 1 employer dimension. Name fallbacks may merge unrelated employers; organization numbers are preferred.

nodes.label: dim_government
nodes.description: Governments since 1991, from seeds/parliament/governments.csv with a source per row.

nodes.label: dim_indicator
nodes.description: Every indicator in fct_indicator, with unit, welfare domain and direction.

nodes.label: dim_job_ai_governance_archive
nodes.description: One row per counted archive with its source URL, SHA-256 and the dictionary's SHA-256.

nodes.label: dim_library
nodes.description: Every library in KB's Biblioteksdatabasen, with municipality, type and position.

nodes.label: dim_location
nodes.description: Location dimension keyed by the complete source location tuple, including country to distinguish non-Swedish locations.

nodes.label: dim_market_field
nodes.description: Occupation fields (yrkesområden), with their latest label.

nodes.label: dim_market_occupation_group
nodes.description: Occupation groups (SSYK 4) as the ads name them, each in its occupation field.

nodes.label: dim_municipality
nodes.description: Every SCB municipality code in use since 1974: today's codes from dim_region and the retired ones from seeds/shared/municipality_codes, each with its years of use. Facts with a four-digit municipality code test against it.

nodes.label: dim_occupation
nodes.description: Type 1 occupation dimension retaining source taxonomy identifiers.

nodes.label: dim_parliament_session
nodes.description: Riksmöten with roll calls, the election each followed and the government at its first roll call.

nodes.label: dim_party
nodes.description: One row per party code in the warehouse: the eight Riksdag parties, Ny demokrati, OTHER (small parties summed) and '-' (no party). No bloc: blocs change by period and are in seeds/parliament/governments.csv.

nodes.label: dim_period
nodes.description: Reporting periods: year (2024), quarter (2024-Q1), month (2024-03), pooled_years (2021-2024, Folkhälsomyndigheten's county results) and survey_round (ESS11). start_date and end_date join dim_date; reference_year aligns periods of different types.

nodes.label: dim_philosophy_document
nodes.description: The works with author, year, tradition and translator as first-class metadata.

nodes.label: dim_region
nodes.description: Swedish regions on SCB codes: country 00, counties (2 digits), municipalities (4 digits), AKU's aggregate 0050 and the eight NUTS2 areas used by ESS.

nodes.label: dim_study
nodes.description: Government studies (SOU, Ds) and the ministry memoranda bills name as preparation.

nodes.label: dim_symbol
nodes.description: One row per dictionary symbol with its occurrences in the whole corpus, before the atlas sample.

nodes.label: dim_symbolic_document
nodes.description: One row per book in the corpus with its metadata, word count, Gutenberg id and source URL. No text.

nodes.label: dim_tax_decision
nodes.description: Riksdag decisions that changed taxes from 2016, with bill, report and origin.

nodes.label: dim_tension
nodes.description: Analytical tensions with the anchor sentence of each pole (interpretation).

nodes.label: dim_text_chunk
nodes.description: Sampled chunks with full provenance.

nodes.label: fct_ai_speech
nodes.description: One row per speech, whether it mentions AI and whether it names the AI Act; the denominator for every share.

nodes.label: fct_bill
nodes.description: Government bills since 2006/07.

nodes.label: fct_bill_report
nodes.description: The committee reports each bill was dealt with in.

nodes.label: fct_bill_study
nodes.description: The studies each bill names in its preparation, with the sentence that names them.

nodes.label: fct_budget_frame
nodes.description: The corrected budget frame, one row per session, proposer (GOV or a party) and expenditure area. The rows are still produced by platform/legacy/build_gold.py (gold/tables/ fact_budget_frame.json); this model carries their tests and measures. Incomplete years and missing party proposals must not be imputed.

nodes.label: fct_budget_outturn
nodes.description: Statskontoret's annual outturn aggregate per budget year and expenditure area. Delivered as gold/tables/fact_budget_outturn.json. Check historical area definitions before joining a budget proposal.

nodes.label: fct_concept_alignment
nodes.description: Chunk × concept similarity, rank and within-corpus z-score (derived).

nodes.label: fct_cross_domain_similarity
nodes.description: Best representative pair per concept and corpus pair, with a random-pair baseline.

nodes.label: fct_election
nodes.description: Riksdag election results, Sweden, 1973 to the latest election. SCB where it has published, Valmyndigheten otherwise. Ny demokrati's votes (1991, 1994) are inside OTHER in SCB's tables; its seats are its own row.

nodes.label: fct_health_survey
nodes.description: Nationella folkhälsoenkäten (Folkhälsomyndigheten): share with 95% interval and responses.

nodes.label: fct_household_vat
nodes.description: Estimated VAT per household type and spending group (SCB HUT and VAT rates).

nodes.label: fct_indicator
nodes.description: All headline values on one grain. The table to join across domains.

nodes.label: fct_job_ads
nodes.description: One current row per observed job advertisement, rebuilt in full on every build. Not a vacancy count or active-ad snapshot.

nodes.label: fct_job_ai_governance_example
nodes.description: Example ads per term and archive, with a masked context window around the match.

nodes.label: fct_kolada
nodes.description: Kolada key figures by municipality, county and country.

nodes.label: fct_labour_force
nodes.description: AKU labour force survey (SCB). Rate denominator depends on labour_status: employment and participation over population, unemployment over labour force.

nodes.label: fct_language_area
nodes.description: The budget-language audit (reports/budget-language.json): per corpus, method, session, party and expenditure area, the area's share of the party's area-assigned lexical matches. Delivered as gold/tables/fact_language_area.json. Word matches are topic attention, not support.

nodes.label: fct_language_coverage
nodes.description: The speeches, words and matches behind the budget-language audit, per corpus, method, session and party. Delivered as gold/tables/fact_language_coverage.json. Zero matches are not evidence of silence.

nodes.label: fct_library_municipality_year
nodes.description: Public libraries per municipality and year: the four bibstat totals (NULL when partial or an impossible zero, named in set_to_missing) and the population denominator.

nodes.label: fct_library_observation
nodes.description: Public-library observations (Folkbibliotek, Folk- och skolbibliotek) of bibstat's BemanService01, Besok01, Publ199 and Aktiv99, one per library, year and term.

nodes.label: fct_municipal_similarity
nodes.description: SWEDEN C per municipality for the clustering's reference year: its twelve inputs (frozen at the hashes the run recorded), groups and principal components; NULL groups for the ten municipalities left out for a missing value.

nodes.label: fct_municipal_tax_rate
nodes.description: Local income tax, burial and church fee rates per parish and year (Skatteverket).

nodes.label: fct_news_item
nodes.description: News items (SVT, Ekot, the Government) with the parties and topics they concern, and whether they are political.

nodes.label: fct_news_item_party
nodes.description: Each party a news item names, by a party term or by the full name of a politician in office (via).

nodes.label: fct_news_item_topic
nodes.description: Each topic a news item is about.

nodes.label: fct_party_activity
nodes.description: Debate speeches, interpellations and written questions per session and party, from the parliament activity summary. Delivered as gold/tables/fact_activity.json.

nodes.label: fct_party_poll
nodes.description: SCB's party preference survey (PSU) with its margin of error.

nodes.label: fct_party_roll_call
nodes.description: Each party's members' votes and position on each roll call, with the party's role that day.

nodes.label: fct_population
nodes.description: Population on 31 December (SCB). The total over sexes is derived and flagged.

nodes.label: fct_rfc_version
nodes.description: One profiled RFC version from the RFC drift report. Delivered as gold/tables/fact_rfc_version.json. Requirement counts are heuristic extraction.

nodes.label: fct_roll_call
nodes.description: Every roll call since 1993/94. Grain: session x roll_call_id (vote id, plus ':motiv' for a roll call on the reasons for a decision rather than the decision itself).

nodes.label: fct_sfs_document
nodes.description: One row per document in Riksdagen's SFS list (int_sfs_documents) with its numbered paragraphs and passages from int_sfs_corpus_paragraphs. Read by platform/publish/export_sfs.py for the statute-book page.

nodes.label: fct_sfs_passage
nodes.description: One row per passage in int_sfs_corpus_paragraphs with its length, without the text. Read by platform/publish/export_sfs.py for the passage length bands.

nodes.label: fct_sick_leave_cases
nodes.description: Started and ongoing sick-leave cases (Försäkringskassan). F43 is inside F00-F99; never add them.

nodes.label: fct_sick_pay_rate
nodes.description: Sjukpenningtal 2.0 (Försäkringskassan), monthly from 2021, rolling twelve months.

nodes.label: fct_social_survey_country
nodes.description: European Social Survey, weighted by pspwght, per country and round. Intervals ignore the sampling design and are too narrow.

nodes.label: fct_social_survey_region
nodes.description: European Social Survey for Sweden by NUTS2 area, rounds 5 onward.

nodes.label: fct_tax_decision_study
nodes.description: The studies a tax decision's bill names as its preparation.

nodes.label: fct_tax_decision_vote
nodes.description: Each party's vote on each tax decision, in the first substantive roll call of its report.

nodes.label: fct_tax_revenue
nodes.description: Tax revenue per country, year and tax type (OECD Revenue Statistics), share of GDP and national currency.

nodes.label: fct_tax_wedge
nodes.description: Labour taxation per country, year, household type and wage level (OECD Taxing Wages).

nodes.label: fct_topic_session_party
nodes.description: Both topic models' word shares per session, party and topic, from the session topic files. Delivered as gold/tables/fact_topic_session_party.json. Join topics on model_id and topic_id together; the models are not comparable.

nodes.label: int_ai_act_article_actors
nodes.description: Article × actor mentions and "shall" sentences in the current English text (derived by pattern).

nodes.label: int_ai_act_definitions
nodes.description: Article 3's defined terms in the current English text, verbatim.

nodes.label: int_ai_act_documents
nodes.description: Every document of the AI Act's family from Cellar's latest answer, with regulation versions' validity.

nodes.label: int_ai_act_guidance
nodes.description: Commission guidance pages with title and publication date read from the page.

nodes.label: int_ai_act_provision_changes
nodes.description: Provision by provision, how the current consolidated text differs from the Official Journal text.

nodes.label: int_ai_act_provisions
nodes.description: Every article, recital and annex of every fetched version and language, parsed by platform/legal/parse.py.

nodes.label: int_ai_speech_concepts
nodes.description: Speech × concept, counted when the concept occurs in one of the speech's AI paragraphs.

nodes.label: int_ai_speech_paragraphs
nodes.description: Paragraphs passing the AI gate, with the framing concepts found in them (dictionary matches).

nodes.label: int_analysis_months
nodes.description: Complete monthly calendar for the configured analysis_start and analysis_end, inclusive.

nodes.label: int_job_ads_enriched
nodes.description: Classifies roles using versioned title/taxonomy seeds, management exclusions and ambiguity flags. Seniority is inferred from the title.

nodes.label: int_job_assistant_checks
nodes.description: Education and conditions an ad states, each with its sentence.

nodes.label: int_job_assistant_evidence
nodes.description: One row per quote behind a judgement, from the ad (side ad) or the CV (side cv).

nodes.label: int_job_assistant_judgements
nodes.description: One row per matched ad and skill the ad names, with the CV evidence level.

nodes.label: int_market_periods
nodes.description: One row with the latest year and its last complete month, for year-to-date comparisons.

nodes.label: int_parliament_party_roll_calls
nodes.description: How each party voted on each roll call, one row per roll call and party.

nodes.label: int_parliament_roll_calls
nodes.description: One row per roll call, test votes left out; a vote id can carry a substantive and a motivfrågan roll call.

nodes.label: int_philosophy_passages
nodes.description: Each work's own text, cleaned and cut into passages of about 60–220 words.

nodes.label: int_riksdag_speeches
nodes.description: Every speech with a normalised party (null for the chair and speakers without a party).

nodes.label: int_sfs_corpus_paragraphs
nodes.description: One row per paragraph (§) of every fetched SFS document, or per stycke of one longer than 1,500 characters, split as int_sfs_paragraphs is, plus whole-text passages of at most 1,500 characters for each fetched document with no numbered paragraph (the XML texts left out). Paragraph rows are not split further. No embeddings.

nodes.label: int_sfs_documents
nodes.description: One row per document in Riksdagen's SFS list (raw/sfs/catalogue.json), repealed ones kept with their repeal date, with the header fields of the fetched text and the paragraph count.

nodes.label: int_sfs_paragraphs
nodes.description: One row per paragraph (§) of the laws in configs/workers_ai/sfs_selection.yaml, or one per stycke when the paragraph is longer than 1,500 characters; the passages "Fråga lagen" searches.

nodes.label: int_sweden_future_theses_detail_latest
nodes.description: DiVA thesis records from 2019-01 at their latest harvested month, with degree level and HSV area.

nodes.label: int_sweden_future_theses_latest
nodes.description: DiVA thesis abstracts at their latest harvested month, one row per record and theme ('_all' carries the words).

nodes.label: int_symbol_occurrences
nodes.description: One row per symbol word (seeds/symbolic/symbol_aliases.csv) with the previous, matching and next sentence.

nodes.label: int_symbolic_documents
nodes.description: Each book's narrative text without Gutenberg's header and licence or paratext (contents, glossaries, indexes, notes, bibliographies, footnotes; nlp/symbolic/cleaning.py), white space collapsed, words and punctuation kept, with its cleaning audit.

nodes.label: int_welfare_ess_answers
nodes.description: ESS answers, one row per respondent (round, data file, country) and item, within the item's valid range.

nodes.label: int_welfare_health_survey
nodes.description: Nationella folkhälsoenkäten, one row per indicator, region, period, sex and age group.

nodes.label: int_welfare_kolada
nodes.description: Kolada values for municipalities, counties and the country, one row per indicator, region, year and sex.

nodes.label: int_welfare_labour_force
nodes.description: AKU levels and rates, one row per region, period, sex, age group, series type and labour-force status.

nodes.label: int_welfare_population
nodes.description: Population, one row per region, year and sex (T is the derived total).

nodes.label: int_welfare_sick_leave_cases
nodes.description: Sick-leave cases, one row per case type, region, month, sex, age group and diagnosis.

nodes.label: int_welfare_sick_pay_rate
nodes.description: Sjukpenningtal, one row per region, month, sex and age group.

nodes.label: mart_ai_act_changes
nodes.description: Documents, guidance and article-level changes, each with its official source.

nodes.label: mart_ai_act_obligations
nodes.description: Actor × obligation × article with the verbatim sentence, our classification and a plain-language summary.

nodes.label: mart_ai_act_speech_similarity
nodes.description: Per AI Act article, the closest Riksdag AI paragraphs by multilingual embeddings (semantic similarity, derived).

nodes.label: mart_ai_act_term_diffusion
nodes.description: Corpus × term list × term × language × month of the AI Act's own terms in Riksdag speeches and job ads, whole months only (derived; never pooled across corpora).

nodes.label: mart_ai_act_timeline
nodes.description: Application dates and deadlines from the Act and the dates of the documents that made it.

nodes.label: mart_ai_governance_timeline
nodes.description: Month × series of AI in the Riksdag and in job ads, for one timeline with the AI Act's milestones (derived; temporal overlap only).

nodes.label: mart_ai_politics_concepts
nodes.description: Party (or ALL) × period × concept among AI speeches.

nodes.label: mart_ai_politics_examples
nodes.description: Example AI paragraphs per concept (newest first) and every paragraph naming the AI Act.

nodes.label: mart_ai_politics_framing
nodes.description: Framing pairs per party and phase, with a balance only from ten speeches.

nodes.label: mart_ai_politics_monthly
nodes.description: Month × all speeches, AI speeches and AI Act speeches, shares and a three-month rolling share.

nodes.label: mart_ai_politics_party_year
nodes.description: Party × year, share of speeches mentioning AI.

nodes.label: mart_analysis_validity
nodes.description: One analytical validity diagnostic per row.

nodes.label: mart_budget_context
nodes.description: One row per budget year: governing and agreement parties, the adopted proposal, the completeness of imported expenditure frames, and the exact FiU1 point 2 roll call. Delivered as gold/marts/budget-context.json by platform/publish/export_politics.py, which also reconciles it byte for byte against the committed delivery.

nodes.label: mart_budget_language_gap
nodes.description: Exact-key join of the corrected party frame and the language audit, only for party proposals that cover all 27 expenditure areas. Delivered as gold/tables/mart_budget_language_gap.json, where attention_minus_budget_pp is formed. Descriptive difference; speeches may come after the budget proposal.

nodes.label: mart_cluster_assignments
nodes.description: Every published clustering's members (platform/publish/clusters): entity, period, cluster and the cluster's share of the period's assigned entities. Noise (-1) has no share.

nodes.label: mart_cluster_shares
nodes.description: Cluster shares per period and segment with their bootstrap 5-95 % range.

nodes.label: mart_concept_links
nodes.description: Editorial links from a concept to measures elsewhere on the site (interpretation).

nodes.label: mart_concept_passages
nodes.description: Representative chunks per concept and corpus, with provenance.

nodes.label: mart_concept_profiles
nodes.description: Concept × corpus rank-1 and top-3 shares against chance (derived).

nodes.label: mart_concept_relations
nodes.description: Concept × concept relations with an explicit relation type.

nodes.label: mart_county_year_features
nodes.description: Model features per county and year: value, one- and two-year lags, one-year change and gap to the country. Backward-looking only; no imputation.

nodes.label: mart_county_year_overview
nodes.description: County by year, indicators side by side. Descriptive co-variation only, not cause and effect.

nodes.label: mart_county_year_panel
nodes.description: Counties and the country by calendar year, one column per measure, each aggregated by its rule. For regression, correlation and maps. Carries numerators and denominators (unemployed and labour force, sick-pay days and insured) so regions combine correctly. County-level associations describe counties, not individuals.

nodes.label: mart_ess_country_round
nodes.description: ESS weighted means per country and round, plus pooled NORDIC and EU27 groups computed from respondents with the analysis weight. Compare rounds within a country only with survey_mode in view (ESS10 self-completion).

nodes.label: mart_ethics_agreement
nodes.description: Gemma against the ETHICS labels per subset and wording, with the majority baseline and the label-shuffle null.

nodes.label: mart_job_ad_municipality_field
nodes.description: Distinct job ads per year, SCB municipality and occupation field, from one DuckDB pass over the JobTech cluster corpus (2023 to 2026-Q3); share within municipality and year.

nodes.label: mart_job_ad_occupation_month
nodes.description: Distinct job ads per publication month and occupation group.

nodes.label: mart_job_ad_unmatched_municipalities
nodes.description: JobTech municipality names with no current SCB match, and how many ads carry them.

nodes.label: mart_job_ai_governance_terms
nodes.description: Month × term × occupation field with denominators, rolling share and year-on-year change.

nodes.label: mart_job_ai_governance_yearly
nodes.description: Year × term × field.

nodes.label: mart_job_assistant_ads
nodes.description: Current Data/IT ads and those removed in the last 30 days, without the text.

nodes.label: mart_job_assistant_checks
nodes.description: Education and conditions the detailed ads state; they never change the class.

nodes.label: mart_job_assistant_evidence
nodes.description: The quotes behind each published judgement, from the ad and from the CV.

nodes.label: mart_job_assistant_judgements
nodes.description: One row per detailed ad and skill it names.

nodes.label: mart_job_assistant_matches
nodes.description: One row per matched current ad, in rank order, with the profile version and CV it used.

nodes.label: mart_job_assistant_profile
nodes.description: The approved profile version and CV the published matches used, and the last run's AI use.

nodes.label: mart_job_assistant_runs_daily
nodes.description: Hourly runs per UTC day, the record of scheduled operation.

nodes.label: mart_job_assistant_skill_demand
nodes.description: Per skill, how many matched Data/IT ads name it and the CV's evidence level for it: how the documented experience compares with what the current ads ask for.

nodes.label: mart_job_assistant_texts
nodes.description: The full public text of exactly the detailed ads, contact details redacted.

nodes.label: mart_job_trends_monthly
nodes.description: One row per month and role, counting distinct source advertisements. Missing coverage yields NULL official totals. Year comparisons need 12 preceding calendar months.

nodes.label: mart_market_archives
nodes.description: The archives counted, with their source URL, SHA-256 and number of ads.

nodes.label: mart_market_conditions_yearly
nodes.description: Ads per occupation field and year by employment type, working hours and required experience; all fields together are in mart_market_conditions_yearly_total.

nodes.label: mart_market_conditions_yearly_total
nodes.description: Ads per year by employment type, working hours and required experience over every occupation field.

nodes.label: mart_market_daily
nodes.description: New ads and vacancies per publication day and occupation field ('all' is the whole market), from JobTech's stream, for the days it has read whole. Preliminary.

nodes.label: mart_market_field_monthly
nodes.description: New ads and vacancies per month and occupation field; the whole market is in mart_market_field_monthly_total.

nodes.label: mart_market_field_monthly_total
nodes.description: New ads and vacancies per month over the whole market, ads without an occupation field included.

nodes.label: mart_market_occupation_yearly
nodes.description: Ads per occupation group and year, in full and over the months the latest year covers (ads_ytd), with the year before over the same months.

nodes.label: mart_market_period
nodes.description: One row with the latest year and its last complete month, for year-to-date comparisons; int_market_periods for the export.

nodes.label: mart_market_region_yearly
nodes.description: Ads per county, occupation field and year; all fields together are in mart_market_region_yearly_total.

nodes.label: mart_market_region_yearly_total
nodes.description: Ads per county and year over every occupation field.

nodes.label: mart_moral_foundation_agreement
nodes.description: English agreement per foundation on MFRC's test split, beside the human ceiling and eMFD.

nodes.label: mart_moral_foundation_shares
nodes.description: Flagged share of sampled Riksdag passages per validated foundation, year and party.

nodes.label: mart_moral_party_spread
nodes.description: Between-party spread per validated foundation; finding when Holm p is below 0.05.

nodes.label: mart_moral_swedish_check
nodes.description: The stop rule; Riksdag shares are published only when passed.

nodes.label: mart_municipality_three_spaces
nodes.description: Neighbour agreement of each municipality across the social, job-ad and vote spaces (docs/sweden-three-spaces-preregistration.md), with the 20 of least agreement ranked (misfit_rank).

nodes.label: mart_municipality_year_cross_subject
nodes.description: Municipality x year across products: welfare panel, local income tax rate, the latest Riksdag election's party shares, public libraries and SWEDEN C's inputs and groups. Connections reads it.

nodes.label: mart_municipality_year_panel
nodes.description: Municipalities by year with the Kolada key figures and population.

nodes.label: mart_national_month
nodes.description: Sweden by month for time-series work: AKU (adjusted, unadjusted, trend), sick-pay rate and components, started cases with rolling twelve-month sums, psychiatric share, and ongoing cases.

nodes.label: mart_news_fetch_status
nodes.description: The latest fetch of each news source and when it last succeeded.

nodes.label: mart_party_pair_session
nodes.description: Share of decisions on which two parties took the same position, per riksmöte.

nodes.label: mart_party_session_record
nodes.description: Attendance, unity, winning side and voting with the government, per party and riksmöte (decisions only).

nodes.label: mart_philosophy_atlas
nodes.description: Passage × map variant with position and cluster (derived).

nodes.label: mart_philosophy_clusters
nodes.description: Clusters with composition, representatives, distinctive words and review status.

nodes.label: mart_philosophy_tension_poles
nodes.description: The passages nearest each pole of each tension.

nodes.label: mart_philosophy_tensions
nodes.description: Work × tension, distribution of positions along the lens (derived).

nodes.label: mart_quality_checks
nodes.description: One data-quality check result per row.

nodes.label: mart_skill_trends_monthly
